whyChooseUs.title: Tradition, Held Whole
whyChooseUs.quote: What is old must not be antique, it must be alive.

items.d: Five generations of temple astrologers, taught in the classical guru-shishya tradition.
Every reading grounded in Parashara, Jaimini and Nadi literature, never intuition alone.
Consultations by appointment only, held with the confidentiality of a physician.
Prescriptions calibrated to your life, never asking what you cannot faithfully do.

process.title: Five Steps, Held with Care
process.quote: The right path is walked slowly, one lamp at a time.

steps.d: Reserve a private slot at a time of your choosing.
Share date, time and place of birth in confidence.
A one-on-one reading held in person or by call.
Receive personalized mantras, yantras and rituals.
Periodic guidance as the dasha and planets shift.

faq.title: Before You Begin
faq.quote: Ask freely, clarity is itself a first remedy.

items.q: How is a traditional consultation different from an online report?
items.a: A shastric reading examines the interplay of chart, dasha, transits and lineage. Every remedy prescribed considers your capacity to practise it.

items.q: What information do I need to share before booking?
items.a: Your date of birth, exact time of birth as close as possible, and place of birth. If unknown, we can perform a rectification session first.

items.q: Are the remedies difficult to follow?
items.a: Remedies are always calibrated to your life. Some are as simple as a mantra at dawn; others involve pooja on specific tithis.
Absolutely. Every reading, chart and personal detail remains strictly between you and the astrologer.
